Printers.summary:
Class Name: Printers
Base Class: SmartFlow

Description: The Printers class provides comprehensive printer management functionality for iOS Smart app automation. It implements methods for adding, removing, selecting, and verifying printers. The class uses Selenium WebDriver for UI interactions and includes exception handling for TimeoutException and NoSuchElementException. It follows the page object model pattern with flow_name identifier 'printers'. The class includes sleep delays for handling asynchronous UI updates and uses pytest for test framework integration. Key automation patterns include explicit waits, element verification, and robust error handling for printer-related operations.
